lines: The battle between the two ferocious beastmen was ongoing.
Fresh blood flew from the werewolf's body due to a single strike of the weretiger's sharp claws.
As he himself had said earlier, the power of the werewolf and the weretiger, his Kyoudai, was about equal――
But now, the werewolf's movements were sluggish, proportionate to how much of the roar he had been hit by initially.
「Y-Yeah...... Leave it to me......! A nick like this is nothing......!」
He grinned, and continued the fight.
Due to the strong vitality innate to beastmen, any minor injuries would regenerate immediately.
That said, what would happen if he kept receiving those brutal attacks?
「Guguh...... Get a grip!!! Wake up, Tora!! You know me, don't you......?!」
「Kukuku...... No matter how much you call out, it's futile.」
「That beastman is under our spell. It's literally an animal, that just chases after prey.」
The man who appeared to be the incubi's leader smiled bewitchingly.
The weretiger had completely lost its reason.
Thanks to brainwashing (the incubi's forte), it had been turned into a slave that just followed their orders.
In the battle between the two beastmen, the weretiger was in an overwhelmingly advantageous position.
It was probably a matter of time before the werewolf was done in.
Although we had managed to pull Mari and Mai out of range of the beastmen's fight, they were completely dazed and in no condition to get up.
The only fighting forces left on our side were me and Una.
Neither of us specialized in combat, so there was no way we would be able to beat that crazed wereti――
Una said that to me with a face filled with determination.
――Then, seeing that face, I grasped what she was trying to do.

「Of course!! I'm fast on my feet, so I'll be fine!!!
.........Probably.」
Una intended to serve as bait to attract the weretiger by running off with the briefcase.
It had been trained by its brainwashing to chase after the case.
The tiger beastman was the only one here that you could call a formidable enemy.
If we could just get that guy away from this place, we would have a chance of winning, even as we were now. But――
Making an intense groan, the werewolf was sent flying.
Both of the weretiger's bloodshot eyes turned towards Mari and Mai, who couldn't move.
――It was a drastic plan, but there was no choice.
Una took the case, and started bounding away just like a startled hare.
「Hey, hey, Tiger-saaaan!! Can you afford to be looking away～?!」
「I'm about to go throw your precious drugs in the sea♪」
「Hmph. Cheeky. I was wondering what you would do.」
The incubus man smiled bewitchingly at the beastman, and handed down an order.

「Still, it would be a problem if that were to fall into the hands of another organization.
――After it!!」
Una shrieked and took flight, with the weretiger chasing after her furiously.
And then, all that remained was――
「......Did you think that you could beat us as long as that beastman wasn't here? Kukuku, how naive.」
「Well, I don't think it'll be that easy......」
The incubi were surrounding us and slowly closing the distance.
「Where she's concerned...... It'll be fine. I've got an idea.」
「But before that, we have to do something about this.」
The werewolf was injured, and Mari and Mai were still in no condition to stand.
I was worried about Una, but――first we would fight our way out of this predicament.
